status.heading: Land builds from source today. No installer is available to download yet.
status.standfirst: macOS, Windows and Linux all build from the repository. None has a published installer, signature or checksum, so a source build is the only way to run Land today.
status.footnote: Source build: the two-step build in the Land repository's Documentation/GitHub/Building.md. Installer, signing and checksum status is quoted from this page's release manifest.
status.sentence: Nothing here is downloadable yet. Land builds from source on macOS, Windows and Linux; public installers, signing and verification artifacts are still in preparation.

ladder.heading: How far along the line from source to signed artifact.
ladder.standfirst: One axis, five positions, and the state of each. A matrix compares what is true in each column; this line answers a different question - which of these things exists today.
ladder.footnote: The order is the release's, not the page's: source, a build from it, an installer, its checksum, its signature. Positions that are not reached print the state vocabulary's word rather than a blank, so the rail says how far the release has come without claiming it has arrived.

platforms.heading: What each platform's artifact state is today.
platforms.standfirst: The release manifest's own fields, one row per target. The artifact columns are the ones a public release fills in; the architecture column is the one that differs today.

evidence.heading: What the release has a picture of, and what it does not.
evidence.standfirst: One verified capture, printed at plate scale, beside the three screens the manual documents in full and the capture the build carries for each: none.
evidence.footnote: A plate is not a screenshot. The one capture in the build is a texture study of the Land element's material, and it is printed as evidence of the material rather than of the interface; the set beside it says the same thing cell by cell.

requirements.heading: What each platform needs before it builds.
requirements.footnote: Minimum requirements, with the recommended figure in the panel beside it. The processor notes read as a pair: at the minimum your code runs at native CPU speed; at the recommended your work spans every monitor.

install.heading: The source build is the only install path today.
install.standfirst: Two steps in the Land repository, then one command to run the app. Every line is copied from the repository's own building document.
install.footnote: Commands are quoted from the Land repository's Documentation/GitHub/Building.md: Step 1, Step 2, and Running the Application. The well prints each line as the document writes it and copies it without the shell prompt or the trailing annotation.

verify.standfirst: There is no artifact to check yet. These are the fields the first installer will publish, and the check that will apply to it.
verify.footnote: The check is the standard one for the artifacts this record promises: the digest the installer publishes, and the PGP signature the masthead marks as planned. On Linux, sha256sum prints the same digest as shasum -a 256.

manifest.title: Release Manifest
manifest.heading: Release Manifest
manifest.subtitle: Source builds are active today. Public installers, signing and verification artifacts are still in preparation.
manifest.headline: RELEASE_01 lists three platforms and publishes no artifact.
manifest.footnote: The manifest carries a release index, a channel and a per-platform status. It carries no version, no release date and no artifact size - those print UNAVAILABLE until a public installer publishes them.
manifest.empty: No release is published. The manifest prints the fields it cannot fill as UNAVAILABLE; the source build is the only path that exists.

transparency.title: Telemetry Is Compile-Gated in Land.
transparency.subtitle: Telemetry and tracing sit behind named Rust feature gates in the native layer. Nothing is emitted by default; each build profile explicitly lists which paths are compiled in.

matrix.caption: INSTALLER, SIGNATURE, CHECKSUM and SIZE are this page's release manifest fields. UNAVAILABLE means no public value has been published.
